chapter: Later career, civil service and jazz seminars
title: Jazz seminars at City College and other colleges
summary: About three years ago he began bringing small groups to college jazz seminars.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: Well, what did you mean, though, where you were teaching. Didn't you say you were teaching in (crossed out: City College)?
seminars (crossed out: little jazz, something about it), kids would come up, you know.
Where do you do -- when do you do -- when did you start doing this?
Well, how often do you do it?

Well, off and on, say, like would come to public relations, they called me and said, Caldwell, want you to get a group to go over there and go on our to South Campus and do a solo. They're advertising in the college paper. Just like Earl Warren used to bring a group over there quite often, Dizzy Gillespie and different ones. I mean that's where most of your musicians are now, like Fordham University, CCNY, NYU. They have all these little jazz seminars.
Well, what do you do at those seminars?
You play these different numbers. then you --
Do you go down alone or with a group?
Oh, no, you get your group.
Yeah, four -- people, they got to be known in the jazz world because the program is made out.
Well, who do you take as a rule?
